title: Alarm data
description: Data of the event alarm.<name>.vN: one schema for all alarms (OBS-6). Only code produces an alarm: the core or a worker of kind job (INJ-7). The state firing opens an episode and resolved closes it; a repeated firing with the same alarmkey writes no event, it increments the episode's repeat_count (spec/lifecycles/alarm.md).

alarmkey.description: Episode key: the alarm name without alarm. and .vN, a colon and the subject id from the catalog, for example disk.free.low:db1.

subject.description: Alarm subject: kind and id from the catalog, or the name of a farm object.

kind.description: Subject kind, for example resource, worker, loop, store, workspace, tenant.

id.description: Id from the tenant catalog or the name of a farm object (for example db1, res:ctd1:data).

values.description: Alarm values: only numbers and enum values (codes), without texts or people's ids (OBS-6, MON-1).
